wingReviews.name: 검은바위 나락
wingReviews.evidence: Launch explicitly states Korean April 3. Official wing article dated April 3 names Grim Patron, Gang Up, Resurrect, Emperor Thaurissan, hunter Quick Shot and mage Dragon's Breath rewards.

wingReviews.name: 화산 심장부
wingReviews.evidence: Official wing post dated April 10 names all six rewards. Contemporary Inven report explicitly says Korean April 10 at 10:00 opening, with Warrior Axe Flinger and Shaman Lava Shock challenges.

wingReviews.name: 검은바위 첨탑
wingReviews.evidence: Official reward mapping confirmed. Official web post displays April 16, but contemporary Korean Blizzard press release carried by Kbench April17 10:59 and Inven April17 11:31 says opened today. Retain Korean April17, not the announcement date.

wingReviews.name: 검은날개 둥지
wingReviews.evidence: Official article names the seven rewards and Warlock/Rogue challenge mapping. Official web post displays April23, but Korean Blizzard press release carried by Bodnara April24 11:08 says opened today. Retain April24.

wingReviews.name: 숨겨진 연구실
wingReviews.evidence: Contemporary Korean Inven May1 11:17 launch report names all six rewards, explicitly including Paladin Solemn Vigil after wing completion. June7 2015 Korean reward summary and wiki corroborate mapping. Official Korean fifth-wing launch article was not located; the 2015-04-16 press-kit upload timestamp is NOT an unlock date.

releaseConclusion: Existing 31 collectible cards' five wing dates and class-challenge placement agree with the above evidence. Do not automatically assign these dates to later-created tokens; verify each token's initial usable appearance separately. OG_044b is not a 2015 release.

patch272.finding: All four named BRM originals match the announced 27.2 stats/text in the 27.2 archive. No original-card delayed stat-application conflict observed for these four. BRM_007 Gang Up remains cost2 with the same effect, not part of this table.
